key_claims: The Taliban is not fighting al-Qaeda and lets it run training camps across Afghanistan; the CIA deputy director's claim that the Taliban is an effective counterterrorism partner reflects politicized intelligence and self-deception dating to the 2013 Qatar office.

Taliban commander Qari Baryal, now a governor, took IRGC money in Kabul as part of the Kabul Attack Network and led the IED cell that killed Capt. Jesse Melton III in 2008; NGIC reporting on him helped families win a lawsuit against Iran for supporting the Taliban and al-Qaeda.
The Taliban's 22 Aug 2024 decrees codify total control of women (face covering, no voices in public, no travel without a mahram) enforced partly by female informants.
Blame for the Afghan outcome spans Bush, Obama, Trump and Biden, but the manner of the 2021 withdrawal is the worst decision, and the Biden administration is drifting toward recognizing the Taliban.
Western-trained Afghan officers in exile (Alizai, Sadat) are the hosts' main source of hope, though diaspora figures will be contested inside Afghanistan.
Taliban figures travelling to Europe (e.g., Germany 2023) and Republic embassies closing at Taliban request signal creeping normalization.
